title: Scanned Symbol at an Interior Position
statement: For every bit string $x$, control state $q$ among the six states or the halting state, output string $w$, and natural number $j<|x|$, a configuration with input head at position $j+1$ scans the bit $x_j$.
hypotheses_covered: $q$ is an optional state among the six states
replaced:
For the six-state diagonal pairing machine on an input string $x$, in any
configuration whose input head sits at position $j + 1$ with $j < |x|$, the
scanned input symbol is the $j$-th bit of $x$, for every control state and
every output string.
